description: Send Postcard lets you design a physical postcard and send it anywhere in the world, all from within a conversation. Open the built-in editor to compose your message and choose your image, then place an order through a secure Stripe checkout. Once payment is confirmed, the order goes straight to a print-and-mail partner who handles printing, addressing, and delivery. You get a live status update at each stage: pending, shipped, refunded, or expired. People love it for birthday greetings, travel notes, thank-you cards, and staying in touch with family without leaving the chat. This app does not cover digital greeting cards, email campaigns, gift wrapping, merchandise printing, poster or canvas orders, package shipping, or any intent beyond designing and mailing a standard physical postcard.
